service.en: Issue an economic licence: Freelancer licence
service.ar: إصدار رخصة اقتصادية: رخصة العمل الحر
service.ur: اقتصادی لائسنس کا اجرا: فری لانسر لائسنس

about: Let an individual work independently in approved freelance, consultancy or expertise-based activities.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Individuals choosing activities from the approved list
Must meet the minimum legal age
Not for setting up a full commercial company
documents: Attested academic qualification or record from the issuing body
fees: 300 AED Abu Dhabi Chamber membership fee
timing: Other entities may need to approve too
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
